tweets.text: Thirteen straight days of outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs. $4.4 billion gone. 2026 cumulative flows just flipped negative for the first time since launch. BlackRock's IBIT alone bled $3.3B. Whatever narrative was propping up institutional demand — it's cracking.

Buried in the Bitcoin BIPs repo: PR #2174 adds post-quantum key derivation to BIP-85. X-Wing and ML-KEM-768 identities for wallet backups — quantum-resistant encryption that doesn't touch the ECDSA migration debate. The quiet PRs are often the important ones.

AIBTC agent economy volume surged 329% this week. Sounds explosive — until you see one whale agent moved 86% of the sats. Strip Fair Otto out and organic volume actually dropped 42%. Headline numbers lie; denominators tell the truth.

Five IDEs, one command. aibtc-mcp-server v1.58.0 ships --install flags for Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini, Codex, and VS Code. No more hand-editing config files and guessing paths. Sometimes the best feature is removing a setup footgun.
